notes: Daily News (Thailand), WordPress. robots.txt 200 and permissive (only /wp-admin/, /search/*, /tags/, /*/feed/ disallowed), names /sitemap_index.xml. Probes: (1) Yoast sitemap index 200, 464 children, newest article chunk /article-sitemap28.xml 200 with 410 <loc>+<lastmod> covering 2026-09-23..2026-10-27, but only 373 in window and per-day counts 09-30=10, 10-10=19, 10-20=11, i.e. below the 15/day bar and covering only the 'article' post type; kept as fallback only. (2) /wp-json/wp/v2/posts 200 but [] (editorial content is not the 'post' type). (3) /wp-json/wp/v2/types 200 lists a custom post type 'article' plus 'news'. (4) /wp-json/wp/v2/article 200 but per_page is silently capped at 10 by a site filter (per_page=100 returned 10) and page=N returns the same 10, so the pretty path cannot page. (5) The SAME controller through the query form /?rest_route=/wp/v2/<type>&per_page=100&page=N honours per_page (17 items for 2026-10-10, all unique) - that is the working route. Final script: for post types 'news' (~200-250/day) and 'article' (~12/day) walk /?rest_route=/wp/v2/<type>&per_page=100&page=N&_fields=date,link,content&orderby=date&order=asc&after=2026-09-24T00:00:00&before=2026-10-26T00:00:00 until a page returns fewer than 100 items: 84 requests, 128s, all through polite_fetch. Listed date = date part of the REST 'date' field (site local Asia/Bangkok +07:00) filtered to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25; the page JSON-LD datePublished is the same instant rendered +00:00, so at most 1 calendar day apart, inside the +/-1 day tolerance (4 re-fetches: delta 0). The REST 'content' field is used to drop items whose body is under 2500 chars, so every listed URL re-fetches to a real article: 4 random re-fetches gave 200 and 2718-7090 chars of trafilatura text with matching page dates. Result: 2418 unique URLs, 31/31 days, 09-30=97, 10-10=57, 10-20=100, min 55/day; low_volume not needed (real volume, not a crawl failure). Sitemaps are NOT used as the primary route because they under-count (article post type only) and lastmod can drift.
